cases.sentence: В то время поднимется Михаил, ___, защитник твоего народа.
cases.explain: «великий князь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.

cases.sentence: Тогда будет такое ___, какого не было с тех пор, как появились народы, до того времени.
cases.explain: «бедственное время» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.

cases.sentence: Но ты, Даниил, скрой эти слова и запечатай свиток, пока не придут ___.
cases.explain: «последние времена» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”

cases.sentence: Со времени, когда будет отменена ___ и будет поставлена опустошающая мерзость, пройдет тысяча двести девяносто дней.
cases.explain: «ежедневная жертва» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.
